clips.title: 唐纳德·特朗普紧急转向经济白宫：这才是重点

subtitles.en: You're laying out all that's happened here over these last 72 hours in the Middle East, and a certainly a lot has.
subtitles.zh: 你梳理了过去72小时中东发生的一切，确实发生了很多事。

subtitles.en: Yesterday on the show, Jeff Mason, our colleague, who covers the White House, teased the fact he would have a new report out yesterday, focusing on the way in which the President of the United States is trying to talk to the American people
subtitles.zh: 昨天节目中，我们的同事杰夫·梅森透露，他有一份新报告，聚焦美国总统如何向美国人民解释战争动机，以及美伊协议。

subtitles.en: about the motivations for the war, yes, but also that agreement that was signed between the U.S.
subtitles.zh: 现在我们来深入探讨，再次连线杰夫·梅森。

subtitles.en: and Iran. We're going to dig into that more now with Jeff Mason who joins us once again on this Sunday morning.
subtitles.zh: 杰夫，很高兴和你通话。你揭示的是，总统试图从经济角度来阐述。

subtitles.en: Jeff, great to speak with you. And what you lay bare there is the President is trying to couch this in economic terms.
subtitles.zh: 他大谈汽油价格和油价，将其视为美国经济更美好的一天。

subtitles.en: He's really job boning a lot about gasoline prices and oil prices and presenting this as sort of something that's going to lead to a better economic day for America.
subtitles.zh: 他在哪些场合这样做？美国民众反响如何？

subtitles.en: What are the venues in which he's doing that? How resonant is that so far with the American people?
subtitles.zh: 大卫，谢谢。他在演讲和活动中提及，这些活动本不聚焦伊朗。

subtitles.en: Yeah, David, thank you. I'm talking about it at speeches and events that aren't necessarily supposed to be focused on Iran.
subtitles.zh: 任何总统都可以在活动中谈论任何话题，这并不罕见。

subtitles.en: And that's not unusual for any President, any President can bring up any topic that they want to at events like this.
subtitles.zh: 但上周他在一个本应是经济主题的活动中提到了这一点。

subtitles.en: But to your question, he brought it up last week during what was supposed to be an economic themed event
subtitles.zh: 但针对你的问题，他上周在一次本应是经济主题的活动上提到了这一点

subtitles.en: in Pennsylvania and then at a rally on the National Mall, the following day or a day later.
subtitles.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州，随后一天在国家广场的集会上。

subtitles.en: So it's certainly being sprinkled into his speeches, being sprinkled into his events as the White House wants him to pivot towards an economic focus,
subtitles.zh: 所以这确实被穿插在他的演讲和活动中，因为白宫希望他转向经济焦点。

subtitles.en: which I might remind everyone was what they had planned for him to do all spring.
subtitles.zh: 我要提醒大家，这原本就是他们计划他整个春天要做的事情。

subtitles.en: And that was, of course, upset by the fact that he ended up bringing the United States into war along with Israel against Iran.
subtitles.zh: 当然，这被他最终带领美国与以色列一起对伊朗开战的事实打乱了。
